title: Spain Under Pressure: Ceuta Crisis and Inflation Squeeze Test Sánchez on Two… · 15 Sep
keywords: Spain, Ceuta, migration crisis, Pedro Sánchez, Morocco, inflation, economic growth, eurozone, EU migration policy, cost of living, border security, HICP, Bank of Spain, Eurostat, fiscal policy
notes: A mass migration crossing into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta has triggered a political firestorm, exposing divisions over border policy and diplomatic relations with Morocco. Meanwhile, Spain's headline economic growth is being overshadowed by an acceleration in inflation, leaving households facing prices that have risen faster than wages. Together, the two crises place Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez in a position of defending both the country's security credibility and its economic record simultaneously.
